html:
DeHub is a censorship resistant, open source alternative to legacy media platforms servicing the content creation, streaming and gaming industries. An ecosystem where anyone can monetise from the first view, without fear of being deplatformed, shadow banned, silenced or manipulated in anyway to be anything but their true self. To speak and think free, away from the hive mind, express as desired.

The app is scaled via a decentralized miner network, providing shared computing power to host, transcode, and deliver content that by design, should live forever.

As the first protocol to tokenise content back in 2023, we've built a sustainable socialfi solution that empowers creators and consumers with a plethora of tools. Features include encrypted private communications, on-chain PPV releases, tradable subscriptions, paid DMs, unlockable content, shared ad revenue and many more these docs cover in full.

Sign up with Google, Apple, email or SMS and have a wallet generated for you in a few clicks. No private key management or custody, you are in full control of your assets and we never access your funds.

Given that data is the new oil, it may be wise to build your core community base here and utilise your existing social media apps to funnel users in to grow your own valuable database and ensure you remain censorship resistant. No matter what happens, never lose touch with your audience, fans, community or customers.

Accounts & Signing In

There are five ways into DeHub and none of them require you to already own a wallet. Sign in with Google or Apple, with a code sent to your email address, with a code sent by SMS, or by connecting a wallet you already use. Everything except the wallet route generates a non-custodial wallet for you in the background: you hold the keys, we never take custody, and gas is sponsored so you can post, tip and collect without ever buying a native token.

One person can run several identities from the same browser. Profiles are managed in Settings → Profile: add an account, switch between them, and DeHub swaps the whole session — wallet, feed, messages and notifications — in one step. Adding a profile never signs you out of the one you are on, and a switch that cannot be completed rolls back to where you were. How many profiles you can park in the list scales with your staking badge.

  • Social sign-in: Google or Apple, one tap, wallet created for you and gas sponsored from the first post.
  • Email or SMS: Enter an address or a phone number and confirm the code that arrives. The same two routes migrate a legacy DeHub account onto the new stack.
  • Existing wallet: Connect MetaMask, Rainbow, Trust or anything WalletConnect speaks to, and sign once to prove the address. Wallet users pay their own ETH or BNB gas.
  • Multiple profiles: Keep several accounts side by side in Settings → Profile and switch without logging out and back in. Your badge tier decides how many you can hold.
  • New members: Everyone who joins lands in the New Members directory, and carries a new-member chip next to their name for their first thirty days so the community can spot and welcome them.

Feeds & Content Formats

The DeHub home surface is a single tabbed feed that carries every content format at once. Instead of forcing creators into one medium, the feed blends text, images, long-form video, short-form reels, music and live streams into one scroll, and lets viewers narrow to a single format whenever they want. Every card, regardless of format, carries the same social and monetisation controls: like, comment, repost, quote, bookmark and tip in DHB.

Formats are surfaced as tabs across the top of the feed. The default Home tab interleaves everything from the people and communities you follow; the dedicated tabs isolate one medium so you can, for example, browse only long-form video or only music. Ranking is driven by the platform leaderboard algorithm documented further down this page, so quality and engagement, not ad spend, decide reach.

  • Home Feed: A mixed feed of text, image and video posts. Likes, comments, reposts, quotes, bookmarks and DHB tipping are built into every card, and posts can be gated, made pay-per-view or set to watch2earn.
  • Shorts: A vertical, swipeable short-video reel for TikTok-style viewing. Direction-locked swipe gestures move between clips, momentum is capped so you never skip two at once, and monetisation applies to every clip.
  • Stories: Record ephemeral stories directly in the app. The overlay editor adds text, emoji and stickers before you publish to the stories bar at the top of the feed, where they expire after 24 hours.
  • Polls: Create poll posts and collect votes inline in the feed. Results update live and can be used to drive community decisions or governance sentiment.
  • Dedicated Tabs: Switch between Videos, Images, Music and Live tabs to browse a single format at a time, each with its own layout tuned to that medium.
  • Bookmarks & Leaderboard: Save any post to your private bookmarks for later, and track the top creators on the platform leaderboard, ranked by the algorithm described below.
  • Reactions: Nine reactions sit behind the like button — like, love, respect, hot, lol, sad, cry, dislike and poo. The seven positive ones all count towards the post's like total; dislike and poo count against it. The tray shows who reacted and with what, and the leading icon on a card is whichever reaction the post drew most. A reaction is weighted by the reactor's badge, so who reacted matters as well as how many did.
  • Comments & Threads: Every post carries comments with their own likes and dislikes. When an author replies to themselves the run becomes a numbered thread, so a story told across several comments reads top to bottom instead of scattering.
  • Mature Content: Creators mark a post as mature while composing it. Mature posts stay off the public home feed and out of search, but remain fully visible on the creator's profile and to anyone following them. Viewers who want them everywhere turn on "Show mature content" in settings.
  • Mute & Block: Mute an author straight from any post with the X in the card header, and they drop out of your feed immediately. Blocking from the profile goes further and cuts messaging too.
  • Automatic Translation: Posts and comments translate into your language as you scroll, in over a hundred languages, with no wallet connection and no setting to find. Tap through to the original at any time.

Upload

On the above user upload dashboard, notice how simple it is for anyone to instantly upload content and in a few clicks enable the following:

  • Watch2earn: every token now has sustainable watch2earn utility at the click of a button
  • Token gated content: stream or upload content locked behind any token contract viewers must hold
  • PPV events: charge any token for a pay-per-view or live stream
  • NFT collectables: mint a post as an NFT and it carries the lifetime royalty attached to the video. Minting is optional — a post publishes instantly off-chain, with no wallet and no signature, and can be minted later from the post itself
  • Earn: DeHub tokens via tips through supporters and rise up on the leaderboards for larger shares of ad revenue
  • Subscribers: Upload or stream content exclusively for your subscribers

Daily posting allowance

Posting on DeHub is free every day, up to an allowance that scales with your staking badge. Everybody starts with ten text posts and one gigabyte of video, images and audio per day. Go past either one and the rest of that day is paid for in DHB — 10c a text post, $2 a gigabyte, charged only on the part that runs over.

Text posts and media are separate pools. Running out of one does not touch the other, so a day spent uploading video still leaves all ten text posts free. Both reset at midnight UTC.

The order matters, and it is deliberate: you are never charged for a post that did not publish, and you never upload a large file only to be told afterwards that you cannot pay for it.

  • Before the upload The app checks the price against what you have already posted today and confirms your wallet can cover it. Nothing is charged, and nothing is uploaded until it passes.
  • The post publishes Your post goes live exactly as it would inside the free allowance. Publishing never waits on a payment.
  • Then you pay One transfer, one signature, for that post only. It settles on whichever of Base or BNB Chain holds enough DHB.
  • If you decline The post stays published. The unpaid amount stays open against your account and blocks your next paid post until it is settled — but never a free one. Whatever tomorrow's allowance gives you is always yours, whether or not anything is outstanding.

What counts against it

  • Text-only posts spend one of your daily text posts each.
  • Video, image and audio posts spend their file size against the data allowance — thumbnails included, since those are stored and served too.
  • Quote posts count exactly like the post they are: a quote with a video attached spends data.
  • Overage is pro-rata, not rounded up to a whole gigabyte. If 200 MB of an upload runs past your allowance, you pay for 200 MB.
  • Reposts, comments, reactions, tips and messages cost nothing and never touch the allowance.

A badge moves both halves at once — a bigger free allowance and a lower price on anything past it. The discount is the same ladder badge holders already get when buying DHB, from 5% at Crab to 30% at Megalodon, so there is one answer to what a badge is worth. Your allowance comes from the badge you earned: a tier lent to you by a patron shows on your profile, but it does not hand you their posting allowance.

Tokenised Content & Fractionalised Ownership

Any upload or livestream on DeHub can be minted as an ERC-1155 NFT fractionalised into exactly 1,000 pieces. Minting is optional: a post publishes off-chain the moment you send it — no wallet, no signature, no gas — and you can mint it whenever you want from the post itself. Once minted, creators have complete control over how many fractions to sell or keep, creating a novel monetisation model where fans can invest in content they believe will succeed - essentially "betting" on the future of potential stars through a revolutionary form of fan tokens.

  • Any upload or stream can mint an ERC-1155 NFT
  • Automatically split into 1,000 fractions
  • Mint at publish, or any time afterwards
  • Choose how many fractions to sell
  • Retain control over distribution
  • Content earns ad revenue for life
  • Permissionless residual income
  • Censorship-resistant earnings

DeHub creates the first platform where fans can financially invest in creators they believe will become successful. By purchasing fractions of content NFTs, supporters become stakeholders in a creator's journey, earning returns when their chosen creators achieve success through ad revenue, tips, and other monetisation streams.

DeHub's ERC-1155 fractionalised content model represents the evolution from temporary creator-fan relationships to permanent economic partnerships. By automatically tokenising every upload into 1,000 tradeable fractions, we're creating the first platform where content success directly and permanently benefits everyone involved - creators, fans, and investors - for all eternity, without requiring ongoing effort or platform dependency.

Customise and update your public profile or channel

Control what users can or can't see while being able to export your followers' data at any time. This gives you full ownership of your channel and allows you to take your business anywhere with you, no matter what happens.

Top Up Tokens In 2 Clicks

We have our own in app currency, similar to Vbucks you get on Fortnite or TikTok coins, ours are called DeHub Tokens or DHB for short. You will see these as gold coins across the app. DHB tokens are used for premium services such as tips, subscriptions & more. Browsing is free, and so is posting inside the daily allowance every account gets — if you sign up with socials, email or SMS, we sponsor all gas fees for you. Wallet users pay standard ETH or BNB gas. Top up DHB in 2 clicks with below.

Tokens are used for subscribing to creators, tipping streamers or unlocking content. The more you hold, the lower your fees are and the more superpowers you unlock like timeline trend boosts and verification badges.

DeHub tokens serve as utility tokens within our ecosystem, similar to in-game currencies, and are not investment vehicles. While our blockchain infrastructure provides unprecedented transparency and verifiable on-chain data for educational purposes, all markets carry inherent risks. You could lose your entire investment due to market volatility, technical issues, security breaches, or unforeseen circumstances. Only participate with funds you can afford to lose completely. DeHub and its affiliates assume no responsibility for any financial losses incurred.

Explore The App & Beyond

Search bars aggregate YouTube and other major streaming app APIs to save you juggling multiple apps, while the explore page also houses our live community chat and dedicated leaderboards for:

  • Most views (MV)
  • Most subscribers (MS)
  • Biggest earners (BE)
  • Biggest spenders (BS)

That together will determine ad revenue share (RS). The exact algorithm to this is under beta and subject to change depending on revenue generated (RG)

Flex Your Badge

The more you $DHB tokens you hold, the more rewarding it is, simple as that. This includes but is not limited to the Badge of Honour system that unlocks improved cosmetics on your public profile as well as further enhanced, premium features.

The ladder is priced in dollars

The thirteen tiers, Crab through Megalodon, each cost a fixed amount in dollars rather than a fixed number of tokens. The DHB a tier asks for is that dollar cost at the live price, so a badge means the same commitment whatever the market is doing. Two protections come with it: the requirement never rises above the published numbers if the price falls, and once you have reached a tier you keep it — the badge you earned is locked to the cheapest requirement it was ever earned at, so a dip cannot strip it back off you.

What a badge unlocks

  • A lower fee on tips, pay-per-views, subscriptions and bounties, dropping 0.69% a tier.
  • A bigger free daily posting allowance, and a discount on anything past it.
  • The same discount when buying DHB, from 5% at Crab to 30% at Megalodon.
  • Superpowers, profile cosmetics and more profile slots.
  • More weight on what you do: a view or a reaction from a badge holder counts for more, on the same ladder as governance voting — one without a badge, two at Crab, and a rung more for every tier above it up to fourteen at Megalodon. It is a multiplier on your one reaction, never a second one.

Lend your badge

A badge can be lent. Every rung you have climbed gives you one delegation slot — one at Crab, thirteen at Megalodon — and each slot hands another account your own tier for as long as you leave it there. It exists because influence on DeHub is meant to travel with a group rather than sit on a single wallet: crews, teams and second accounts get the tier their backer holds, without anybody moving tokens or handing over keys.

  • Same tier, not one below: A Megalodon lends Megalodon. A badge claims the influence you command, so the people you back carry what you carry.
  • Slots come from your own stake: A borrowed badge carries no slots of its own, so a lent tier can never be lent onwards.
  • The patron is public: Hover a delegated badge anywhere in the app and it names who is backing it. Nothing is hidden about where a tier came from.
  • Reversible at any time: Take a slot back and the tier returns to you. Your own staking, fee tier and locked badge are untouched by anything you lend.
  • Status, not entitlements: A lent badge is what the platform shows, and it carries the weight that goes with the tier — a view or a reaction from it counts at the tier it was lent. What it does not carry is anything priced in money: your fee tier, your DHB purchase discount, your daily posting allowance and your own delegation slots are all still read from the stake you hold yourself.

Tip Your Favourites

Our Integrated tipping services across all uploads and live streams only come with a 10% fee, compared to the usual 60% charged by the likes of TikTok and other industry leaders while also having the ability to vote on video cancellations putting the power back into the viewer's hands.

Tips received for creators and tips given by viewers are logged in separate leaderboards along with viewer counts and subscribers that determine shares in ad revenue. Stakeholders of DeHub tokens receive their proportionate shares of overall protocol profit.

Mine Through Content Moderation

Only a few wallets hold over 50m $DHB tokens, of which most are operational wallets, with the remaining being known community members.

Only the core team or top tier badge holders will have the power to instantly remove a video by burning the NFT associated. Subsequently, all the ad revenue generated and any play to earn bounties strapped to the video will be shared with all voting wallets to further deter bad actors and incentivise an engaged community.

Our comprehensive governance and moderation system creates a fair, transparent, and community-driven platform that prevents centralized censorship while maintaining quality standards through economic incentives and advanced mechanisms.

  • We use quadratic voting for key moderation decisions.
  • Users can stake tokens to become moderators.
  • Stakers vote on the outcome (ban, warn, ignore, etc).
  • Users can delegate their votes to trusted curators or moderation pools (think: staking to a validator in PoS).
  • Users stake tokens to "curate" or promote content.
  • Content creators can appeal moderation decisions via DAO proposals.
  • Transparent moderation history: Every decision logged on-chain.

Voting on proposals

The design above is what governance is for; the Governance page is where it happens. Proposals are listed under Proposals, Passed and Rejected, each one showing its author, its text and where the vote stands. Holders vote for or against and can discuss a proposal in its comments before deciding. Anything that passes becomes a decision the platform is held to, in public, with the vote attached.

Live Streaming

Our livestreaming platform leverages Livepeer for video streaming infrastructure, powered by a Next.js backend and frontend. Every livestream is permissionless and censorship resistant, offering creators unprecedented control and monetization opportunities while providing viewers with engaging, token-enabled experiences.

  • NFT-backed livestreams minted on BNB or Base chain
  • Integrated tipping with visual effects and tiers
  • Token-gated access for exclusive content
  • Pay-per-view and bounty reward systems
  • Real-time chat and engagement metrics
  • Support for OBS/Streamlabs integration

Go live directly from your browser using your webcam

Use OBS, Streamlabs, or other software with custom stream keys and server URLs

Subscriptions

DeHub is the first protocol to release fully on-chain subscriptions, transforming how creators monetize their content and build communities. Our subscription system combines the benefits of traditional creator subscriptions with the power of blockchain technology, creating tradeable subscription NFTs and unprecedented creator-subscriber relationships.

  • Set custom pricing for each tier
  • Define unique perks and benefits
  • Manage tier-specific content access
  • Automatic NFT minting on purchase
  • Tradeable subscription assets
  • Secondary market liquidity

Create separate group chats for different subscription tiers, allowing for exclusive discussions and closer community interaction based on support level.

Offer exclusive perks like early access to content, private livestreams, personalized messages, merchandise discounts, and special recognition.

Messages

DeHub's messaging system combines traditional social communication with Web3 innovation, offering encrypted messaging, monetized interactions, and advanced privacy controls. Connect with creators and community members through secure, decentralized communication that puts you in complete control of your conversations and data.

  • Send direct messages to any platform user
  • Create group chats with multiple participants
  • Real-time message delivery and notifications
  • Rich media support for photos and videos
  • Cross-platform accessibility
  • Smart replies: two suggested answers drafted under the composer, for both sides of the conversation, that you can send or edit in a tap
  • Attach files as well as photos and video, on phone, tablet and desktop alike

Share photos and videos locked behind custom paywalls, allowing recipients to unlock premium content for any supported token.

All messages are encrypted end-to-end, ensuring only you and your intended recipients can read your conversations.

No third parties, including DeHub, can access your message content. Your privacy is guaranteed by cryptographic protocols.

SuperPowers

App super powers provide users with hacks to boost engagement or raise awareness. Think of it like boosted posts on legacy social platforms, however not limited to just companies or products, anyone can get involved. Paid in DHB tokens, the price fluctuates due to auction style mechanic. Badge holders also unlock a number of superpowers depending on tier.

  • 1) Trend Jacker Have your desired topic appear on the trending list
  • 2) Timeline Bomber Appear on the timeline of all profiles you follow
  • 3) Precision Strike Appear on the timeline of users following accounts you target
  • 4) Harpoon Appear on the timeline of selected badge holders, such as whales, sharks, etc

Fee Tier System

Our revolutionary fee structure rewards $DHB token holders with significantly reduced platform fees. Starting at a standard 10% fee, each badge tier earned through increased $DHB holdings reduces fees by 0.69%, ultimately reaching just 1% for Megalodon badge holders - a 99% fee reduction for our most dedicated community members.

  • Linear 0.69% reduction per badge tier
  • Maximum 99% fee reduction for Megalodons
  • Applies to certain platform services
  • Instant activation upon badge qualification

Fees only apply to certain services such as tips, subscriptions, pay-per-views, and watch2earn bounties. Users can send tokens to other users for free across the app and make use of our abstraction tools to do it with no wallet address or private key management required.

Communities & Events

Communities are member-run spaces inside DeHub. Each one has its own feed, member list, activity stream and notification channel, giving creators and projects a dedicated home for their audience without leaving the platform. Communities are where recurring engagement lives: members post, discuss, run polls and tip one another, and unread activity surfaces as a badge on the bottom navigation so nobody misses what is happening.

Events extend communities with time-bound programming. A community or the platform can schedule an event, publish a dedicated event page with full detail, and let members follow along live when it starts. Together, communities and events give the ecosystem the tools to organise around a shared interest and keep people coming back.

  • Browse & Join: Discover public communities from the Communities page, join in one tap, and receive an unread badge in the navigation whenever there is new activity.
  • Community Feeds: Each community has a dedicated feed where members post, discuss, run polls and tip each other, moderated by the community owner.
  • Events: Browse platform and community events, open an event page for the full agenda and detail, and follow along live once the event begins.

Stages: Live Audio Rooms

Stages are live audio rooms, comparable to Twitter Spaces, built directly into DeHub. A host opens a room, brings speakers on-stage, and any number of listeners can drop in instantly from the Stages page or a shared invite link. Stages are designed for real conversation at scale: hosts control who can speak, listeners send live reactions, and the whole room can be recorded for replay.

What sets DeHub Stages apart is the production layer. Hosts get a DJ-style soundboard that mixes sound effects, their own music clips and live radio stations into the published room audio, plus voice effects, so a stage can feel like a produced show rather than a conference call. Hosts can share their screen, run the whole thing from a browser with no OBS or stream keys, and schedule a room in advance so an audience is waiting before the doors open.

The room is also readable. Live subtitles caption every speaker as they talk and are translated into whatever language each listener is reading in, so a stage can be followed in a language nobody on stage speaks. Live dubbing goes one step further and speaks the room aloud in the host's own cloned voice, billed by the minute in DHB. A live transcript drawer and text-to-speech keep rooms usable without a microphone, and a persistent corner mini-player lets you keep browsing the rest of the app while a stage plays.

  • Host & Speak: Start a stage, invite speakers on-stage, mute or remove participants, and manage the room in real time from the host controls.
  • Reactions & Soundboard: Listeners send live emoji reactions, and hosts drive a DJ-style soundboard with click-free cueing and voice effects mixed straight into the room audio.
  • Transcripts & TTS: A live transcript drawer captions the room as it happens, and text-to-speech lets you participate without a microphone.
  • Recordings: Stages record, and the recording plays back from the card it appears on — seekable, at the speed you choose, sharable and repostable straight from the share sheet. A shared corner player carries it across web and mobile.
  • Schedule & Remind: Announce a stage ahead of time with a short invite link and its own share card. Everyone who set a reminder is alerted when it is about to start, and again the moment it goes live.
  • Subtitles & Translation: Live captions for every speaker, translated into the language each listener is reading. The durable transcript is kept separately once the room ends.
  • Live Dubbing: Dub the room into another language in the host's own cloned voice, paid by the minute in DHB from the wallet.
  • Audience Chat & Screen Share: Listeners talk in a room chat without coming on stage, and hosts share a screen sized for whatever device it lands on.

TV, Music & Radio

Beyond creator uploads, DeHub ships always-on entertainment surfaces so there is something to watch or listen to the moment you open the app. These lean-back experiences run continuously and follow you around the product through floating players, so media never stops when you navigate elsewhere.

  • DeHub TV: Live TV channels with continuous programming and a floating picture-in-picture player that stays pinned as you move around the app.
  • Music Hub: A dedicated music surface with tabs for tracks, music videos, podcasts and live performances, each with its own player.
  • Radio: Stream curated radio stations filtered by genre, with a persistent mini-player and an optional fullscreen audio visualizer.

Wallet & Payments

Every DeHub account comes with a built-in, non-custodial wallet. There are no browser extensions to install and no seed phrases to manage: the wallet is created and secured for you the first time you sign in, and it powers every value transfer in the app, from tipping and pay-per-view unlocks to subscriptions, bounties and creator earnings. Sending tokens to another user is free, and abstraction tools mean most users never touch a raw wallet address or private key.

For creators and power users, the wallet expands into a full finance surface. The Command Centre visualises income over time, breaks down every transaction, and handles cross-chain deposits, while dedicated pages let you buy, stake and bridge DHB without leaving DeHub.

  • Wallet: A multi-token wallet holding DHB alongside ETH, BNB, BTC, USDT and USDC, with live prices and a full transaction history. Receive, Send, Buy, Stake, Bridge and Cash Out are all one tap from the balance.
  • Command Centre: A creator finance dashboard with income charts over time, per-transaction breakdowns and a cross-chain deposit drawer.
  • Buy DHB: Top up your balance directly in the app with card or crypto through the built-in Buy flow.
  • Stake & Bridge: Stake DHB to earn rewards and unlock badge tiers that lower your fees, and bridge tokens between BNB Chain and Base.

Bounty Hunting

Bounty Hunting is DeHub's built-in task and reward system, not a third-party freelance marketplace. Anyone in the ecosystem can post a bounty, and anyone can become a hunter and claim it, with the reward held safely until the work is delivered. It turns work and engagement into a native part of the platform: the people posting bounties, the hunters completing them and the tokens that settle them all live inside DeHub. Bounties are paid in DHB or USDC.

Because it is native, Bounty Hunting doubles as a growth engine for the whole ecosystem. Creators use it to drive engagement and build their communities by posting bounties for shares, clips, reactions or content that spreads their work. Projects and the wider DeHub community use it to self-promote and grow the ecosystem, rewarding hunters for the tasks that bring new people in. The same system that settles a contract also settles a community engagement task.

  • Post a Bounty: Anyone can post a bounty with a clear brief and a reward in DHB or USDC, whether it is a piece of work to be delivered or an engagement task like sharing, clipping or promoting content.
  • Become a Hunter: Browse open bounties, filter by category or currency, claim the ones you want, and submit your work to collect the reward. Every user can be a hunter, no application or gatekeeping required.
  • Bounty Categories: Bounties are organised into Social Media, Clipping and Contracts, so engagement tasks and longer pieces of work each have their own lane.
  • Escrow Protection: Every reward is held in escrow the moment a bounty is posted, and only released to the hunter once the work is accepted, protecting both sides.
  • Engagement & Growth: Creators post bounties to grow their communities, and the DeHub community posts bounties to self-promote and expand the ecosystem, turning promotion into a rewarded, trackable activity.
  • Disputes: A dedicated dispute flow resolves disagreements over delivery, so escrowed rewards are always settled fairly.

Stores

Stores let creators and businesses open a native storefront inside DeHub and sell directly to their audience, settled in DHB. A store lives on its own page, sits alongside the creator's content, and turns followers into customers without redirecting them to an external checkout. Because payment runs through the same built-in wallet as the rest of the app, buyers can purchase in a couple of taps and sellers receive DHB straight to their balance.

  • Open a Store: Any creator or business can set up a storefront with its own page, branding and product listings.
  • Sell in DHB: Products are priced and settled in DHB through the built-in wallet, with no external checkout.
  • Sell to Your Audience: Your store sits next to your content and community, so the audience you have already built can buy without leaving DeHub.

Affiliate & Referrals

The Affiliate program rewards you for growing DeHub. Every account gets a personal referral link and code; share it, and you earn from the activity of everyone you bring to the platform. It is the individual counterpart to the ecosystem growth that Bounty Hunting drives, and it is tracked end to end from the Affiliate dashboard.

  • Your Referral Link: Every account has a unique referral link and code you can share anywhere, including short /r/ links that route new users through your referral.
  • Earn From Activity: You earn 20% from the users you refer, plus 5% recurring from the people they go on to refer, paid in DHB.
  • Track Everything: The Affiliate dashboard shows your clicks, signups and earnings so you can see exactly what your referrals generate.

AI Suite

DeHub bundles a full set of AI tools for creators, all available inside the app with no external accounts or API keys. The suite spans a conversational assistant, autonomous agents and a no-code app builder, so you can go from an idea to generated content or a working mini-app without leaving the platform.

  • AI Assistant: A chat assistant that answers questions about DeHub, generates posters and marketing assets, and helps you plan and create content.
  • AI Agents: Deploy autonomous agents that carry out tasks on your behalf, from content workflows to on-platform automation.
  • AI Builder: Describe an app in plain language and the Builder generates it, then gives you a shareable live preview link to send to anyone. It lives at dehub.io/builder.
  • Creator Studio: A native generation studio for images, video, voice, music and 3D models, with a Canva-style editor on top, a shared render queue that keeps working while you browse, and a free stock asset library to pull from.
  • @assistant: Mention @assistant on a post, in a comment thread or in the live chat and it answers in place using real platform tools rather than keyword matching. It can also file a support ticket that reaches a human.

How generation is paid for

Generation runs on AI credits, denominated in DHB rather than a separate currency you have to buy into. Every account gets a starter grant and accrues more each day, so there is always some free credit to reach for, and the price of a job is quoted by the server before it runs — you see the cost before you spend it. Anything beyond the free accrual comes out of your DHB balance at the same rate. Stage dubbing is billed the same way, by the minute.

Creator Studio & Editor

Creator Studio is where content gets made rather than posted. It generates images, video, music, voice and 3D models from a prompt, keeps a render queue working while you carry on browsing the app, and hands the results to a Canva-style editor for arranging, cropping and captioning. A free stock asset library sits alongside it, so a post can be built end to end without an external tool or a subscription to one.

Next to it is a full video editor that runs in the browser — a real multi-track timeline with cutting, layering and export, not a trim slider. Footage you generated in the Studio, media you uploaded and anything from the asset library all drop onto the same timeline, and the finished cut goes straight into a post, a short or a store listing.

  • Generate: Images, video, music, voiceover and 3D models, across the models the Studio exposes, priced and quoted by the server before a job runs.
  • Edit: A multi-track timeline editor in the browser, with export. Nothing to install and nothing to upload to a third party.
  • Queue & Library: Renders continue in a shared queue while you browse, and a free stock asset library covers the gaps.
  • Credits or a plan: Everyday generation runs on the DHB-denominated AI credits every account accrues. Heavier users can take an Ultra, Team or Scale plan for a monthly credit allowance instead — the plans are listed at dehub.io/pricing.

Arcade

The Arcade is a shelf of games that run inside DeHub in a browser tab. Nothing to install, nothing to buy, no separate account: open one and play. Five titles ship today — King's Gambit, a cinematic 3D chess game with an online Elo ladder; Claude of Duty, a shooter that generates every mesh, texture and sound on your machine as the level loads; Jungle Trail, a first-person walk through a procedurally generated rainforest; Street Slayer, a side-scrolling beat 'em up built for DeHub; and Trenchstar, a trading floor you can walk, with live market feeds on the desk monitors and a VR mode through WebXR.

Two of them are also hidden inside the appearance themes: set the app to War and Claude of Duty is reachable from the theme itself, and the Jungle theme hides Jungle Trail. King's Gambit and Street Slayer keep leaderboards, and every game has its own share card so a link to one unfurls properly wherever you post it.

Advertising Portal

Businesses can run campaigns on DeHub through the self-serve ads portal — create campaigns, top up in DHB, and track performance, with ads served natively into the feed.

Feature Requests

DeHub is built with its community. Submit ideas on the feature request board, vote on other people's requests, and watch them move to Shipped — if a feature you asked for goes live, the app tells you with a personal notification.

Connect AI (MCP)

Link DeHub to ChatGPT or Claude via MCP and use your favourite AI to browse, post and interact with the platform on your behalf. Set it up at dehub.io/connect.

Notifications

Everything that happens to you lands in one notification centre, split into tabs so replies do not bury payments. Comments and replies, reactions on your posts, new followers, tips and purchases, stage reminders and the moment a stage you booked goes live, community activity, and an alert when a feature you asked for on the request board actually ships — all in the same place, with a thumbnail of whatever the notification is about so you can tell them apart at a glance.

  • Choose what reaches you: Per-category preferences in Settings decide what gets sent at all, so you can keep tips and drop reactions.
  • Push on mobile: The mobile app delivers push notifications to your phone; the web app collects the same events in the notification centre.
  • Announcements: Platform-wide announcements arrive through the same centre rather than as a separate inbox to check.

Themes & Appearance

DeHub ships eleven appearance options, not a light-and-dark toggle: System, Light, Minimal, Cosmic, Hazy, Swarms, Lava Lamp, Winter, War, Osaka and Jungle. Each is a full skin — its own palette, chrome, iconography and, for several of them, a live animated background rendered on the GPU. Pick one in Settings → Appearance; four of them also let you set your own accent colour. Island, Hacker and Horror are queued behind them.

Two of the skins hide a game. Set the theme to War and Claude of Duty is reachable from inside it; set it to Jungle and Jungle Trail is. Both are also in the arcade, but the theme is where they belong.

Settings

Settings is one page with everything the app lets you decide, rather than preferences scattered behind the surfaces they affect. It is where you edit your profile, switch appearance themes, add and switch between profiles, and set what reaches you and what does not.

  • Profile & Profiles: Display name, bio, avatar and default profile tab, plus the profile list for adding and switching between several accounts.
  • Appearance: The theme picker, comfortable or compact density, dimmed lights and an accent colour on the themes that take one.
  • Content preferences: Whether mature content appears for you, default post visibility, autoplay and a data-saver mode for metered connections.
  • Who can reach you: Direct message access, blocked accounts, blocked countries, Do Not Disturb and Quiet Hours that silence everything for a window you choose.
  • Notifications: Per-category switches for what is worth telling you about, browser notifications, and email notifications separately.
  • Your data: Export your chats, extract your data, review the devices and sessions signed into your account, and delete your account data.

Get the App

DeHub runs anywhere. The web app at dehub.io is the full product in a browser and installs to your home screen like a native app on both desktop and phone. The Android app is on Google Play, and the latest build is always available as a direct APK from dehub.io/apk for anyone who would rather skip the store. Feeds, stages, posting, messaging, wallet and notifications all work the same on either, and your account, badge and balance follow you between them.

  • Web: dehub.io in any modern browser, installable to your home screen or desktop.
  • Android: On Google Play, or as a direct APK download from dehub.io/apk for Android 8 and up.
  • One account everywhere: The same sign-in, wallet, badge and balance across every surface, with no separate migration step.

More in the App

A handful of smaller surfaces round the app out. None of them need explaining at length, but they are easy to miss if nobody points at them.

  • Guide: An in-app walkthrough of the whole product, screen by screen, for anyone who would rather be shown than read documentation.
  • Glossary: Every icon, feature name and Web3 term the app uses, defined in one place.
  • Stats: Live site statistics — visitors, page views and traffic in real time, published rather than kept internal.
  • Leaderboard & Top 100: The creator rankings that feed ad revenue share, and the top hundred accounts on the platform.
  • Creators: A directory of creators to find and follow, alongside the New Members roster of everyone who has just arrived.
  • AI Agents & Prompt: Deploy agents that act on your behalf, and a prompt surface for getting straight to the assistant with a question.
  • Careers: Open roles on the DeHub team, listed in the app rather than on a separate careers site.
  • Prize Draws: DeHub has run prize draws since the $1,000,000 home raffle in 2022; the current ones live at dehub.io/raffle.
